subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should this issue resolve with provider-id schema guidance only, or should channel also become a plugin-aware enum constraint?
rationale: The description-only repair is narrow and proven, but enum enforcement changes the accepted model-facing schema and must account for dynamically registered channel plugins rather than freezing bundled ids.

options.title: Land description only
options.body: Merge the focused clarification and regression test now, keeping the accepted string surface unchanged and tracking a plugin-aware enum separately if needed.

options.title: Require dynamic enum
options.body: Expand the fix only after deriving values from the registered channel/plugin inventory with tests for external plugin ids and unavailable channels.

options.title: Keep current schema
options.body: Close the implementation candidate and rely on prompt and fallback behavior, accepting continued ambiguity in the structured tool definition.

recommendation.title: Land description only
recommendation.body: Merge the focused clarification and regression test now, keeping the accepted string surface unchanged and tracking a plugin-aware enum separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most recent item-specific review and explicitly framed the description-versus-dynamic-enum boundary.
